description: This file defines the OrBinary class within Twig, representing the logical OR binary expression node in the Twig template engine's abstract syntax tree.

classes.name: OrBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary OR expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, extending AbstractBinary, providing the operator symbol '||'.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the compiler output for the OR operator ('||') when compiling Twig's expression nodes.
